Title: Mitochondria Inherited from Father
Content: It was widely accepted that humans inherit their mitochondria only from their mothers. In `2002`, an individual suffering from fatigue and muscle pain was found to have a mutation in his mitochondrial DNA. DNA sequencing of family members revealed that he had inherited the mutated mitochondria from his father. Since `2002`, evidence of additional cases of children inheriting mitochondrial mutations from their fathers has been found.
